FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
The Stylish Mane operates as a full-service barber and beauty salon located in a dedicated commercial space, specializing in a range of services including haircuts, styling, coloring, and conditioning for both men and women. Our team is comprised of licensed and certified professionals who are committed to providing high-quality services while adhering to all applicable health, safety, and sanitation regulations. We utilize only professional-grade products and equipment to ensure the best results and minimize liability risks. Our salon maintains up-to-date professional liability insurance, ensuring coverage for our operations and compliance with industry standards. We do not engage in high-risk services such as medical or invasive cosmetic procedures, and we focus exclusively on non-invasive beauty services to align with our commitment to safe and professional practices. To support our operational efficiency and client satisfaction, we use a digital appointment management system and have strict sanitation protocols in place. Additionally, we strive to maintain a calm and welcoming atmosphere for our clients, ensuring a positive experience with every visit.

Our salon offers a full range of hair cutting, styling, and coloring services, and we also provide chemical treatments for hair straightening and curling, which are essential to our clients’ desired looks.
